english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when saying that the relevant people or things are included in the total.

examples.english: The price of this set meal includes breakfast and drinks inclusively.
examples.traditional: 呢個套餐嘅價錢包埋早餐同埋飲品。
